SECRET_KEY.description: Flask secret key - SET AS A SECRET in the Railway dashboard with a fixed value (e.g. `python -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_hex(32))"`). Do not use generateValue - it mints a new key on every deploy, which invalidates all logged-in sessions and pending password-reset tokens each time.

DEVELOPER_EMAIL.description: Email address that is allowed to access staff/admin features

SMTP_USERNAME.description: SMTP account username / from address for password-reset emails

SMTP_PASSWORD.description: SMTP password or app-specific password - SET AS A SECRET, never commit it

SMTP_FROM_EMAIL.description: Optional: From address if different from SMTP_USERNAME
